original_source_items.meaning: 13 Class3 connector family rows
J1 five 28VDC supply/return pairs and chassis ground
J2 64 named signal contacts including 4 serial ports and source safety circuits
J1 DC physical pin arrangement
J2 signal physical pin arrangement
Global Class3 J2 table N-key; detailed J2 table A-key
Class3 connector Rules name J10 but global family table omits J10
Source connector-list SHALL and mission-dependent permission require applicability review
Five 28VDC/10A J1 pairs with 14A for two seconds inrush; source original standards not independently tested
J2 table text enumerates 64 pin labels from 1–66 with 18 and 26 unlisted, not presumed reserved
Two Rules inside Class3 say Class1&2 J2 for Ethernet/serial
Arming Rule pins2/95 conflict with J2 table pins2/5
NEZ Rule and unnumbered SHALL pins4/5/11/12 conflict with table pins11/12/13/52
Mode Rule pins89/90/97/98 conflict with J2 table pins53/54/59/65
Distinct Observations on PDF321 and PDF326 both printed 13.5.3.3-1
Power Enable OFF >=100kOhm and ON strictly <5Ohm; no states inferred between limits
Arming/cutout/NEZ/gimbal are physical controls, not software Commands
1PPS rule points to figure13.5.3.3-1 captioned J2 pin arrangement, not verified pulse waveform
Two Class3 hand-controller Rules with differing unconditional vs conditional language
USB2 Host is optional; 5V power conditional when used
Narrative requires NEZ pins4/5/11/12; physically conflicts with detailed J2 table and duplicates numbered source rule

original_source_items.name: C239 original DSDM/IDL and 6 OpenAPI natives

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Physical constituent
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Class3 original connector families and individual keyed instances are hardware interface configurations.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not separate installed Systems or a universal DIM chassis.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Network-visible participant
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: J2 physical Ethernet link design is specified.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No independently IP-addressable or remotely discoverable participant.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Network instance and connection context
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Ethernet and serial channel physical interface options are source-defined.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No actual IP session, address allocation or network service.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Composition member exposure and source attribution
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: J1 per external sensing element and repeated keyed connector descriptions constrain physical designs.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No independently discoverable composition member.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Declared component capability catalogue
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Class3 conformance requires documentation of physical connectors, their variants and non-SOSA exceptions.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not a measured runtime capability or preapproved DIM schema.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Declared command interface
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Arming and gimbal inhibition are hardwired safety inputs.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not authenticated CSAPI software commands.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Supported operating mode
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: NEZ and emissions-mode selection pins address predefined hardware alternatives.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No universal mode enumeration; source connector pin conflicts unresolved.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Source-reported operating mode
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Emission mode source controls pin-level input.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No reported current operating-mode output.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Issued control request
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: External power-enable/gimbal circuits have conditional electrical effects.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No issued digital command or recorded execution request.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Command acknowledgement / reported outcome
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Physical emission annunciation interface provides a source signal.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No digitally acknowledged software command.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Component capability and readiness report
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Connector inventory and Ethernet design reflect declared hardware capability.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No verified source device readiness or network service.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Component property-value report
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Isolated electrical Safety Status signals are specified.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No actual sampled Status resource value.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Required and recommended capability support
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Class3 connector conformance includes mission permissions and documented exceptions.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not universal Profile SHALL, unresolved required-list conflicts retained.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Component time basis and synchronization
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: J2 conditionally accepts a platform rollover pulse.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No actual synchronized UTC clock, resultTime or uncertainty.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported arming state
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Physical MASTER_ARM source contacts are described.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No actually reported arming state or safe software control.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported physical parent/child attachment relationships
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: J1 per element and differently keyed connector descriptions are physical design relationships.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No identified installed physical parent/child assets.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Power-source classification
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Class3 J1 receives power under selected source standards.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not source energy generator or observed battery/mains type.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Source-side DC voltage
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Five designed 28VDC inputs support 10A nominal per pin pair.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not measured source-side voltage telemetry.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported condition of power to the component
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: External Power Enable threshold conditions are normative input design.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No measured source-case current power state.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported output field
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Source J2 table enumerates physical contacts and signal families.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not 64 digital output properties or 64 sensor devices.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: REVIEW HOLD — reporting path
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Physical Ethernet/serial connections could carry traffic.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No observed data flow or CSAPI DataStream.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: REVIEW HOLD — power / state
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: J1 power inrush/nominal/grounding limits are hardware design criteria.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No installed or independently verified electrical conformance.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: REVIEW HOLD — time / QA
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Conditional physical 1PPS pulse may be accepted.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No validated observation clock/source QA.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: REVIEW HOLD — control execution
qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Physical NEZ selection and gimbal disable provisions do not map to CSAPI commands.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No authorized execution, independent safety verification, or resolved pin assignments.

exact_holds.description: Class3 family connector table J2 N-key conflicts with detailed J2 table A-key.
Rule13.5.3.1-2 names J10 in conformance list but original Class3 connector family table omits J10.
Rule13.5.3.1-2 lists required connectors while Permission13.5.3.1-3 allows mission-dependent omissions.
J1 original MIL-STD704F/1275E and MIL-STD1310 originals not audited; 10A nominal/14A inrush/1MΩ/0.1Ω not physically tested.
J2 original 19-35 connector figure, exact dense modality checkmarks and contact pixel geometry not verified.
J2 64 text-registered pin numbers leave 18 and 26 unmentioned; no assumption of reserved wiring.
Class3 J2 Ethernet Rule13.5.3.3.2-2 explicitly says Class1&2 J2; applicability conflict.
Class3 J2 serial Rule13.5.3.3.3-1 explicitly says Class1&2 J2; applicability conflict.
MASTER_ARM Class3 Rule pins 2/95 conflict with table 2/5; no silent pin reassignment.
NEZ Class3 Rule/un-numbered SHALL pins 4/5/11/12 conflict with table 11/12/13/52.
Emissions-mode Rule pins 89/90/97/98 conflict with detailed J2 table 53/54/59/65.
Two different Observations use source ID13.5.3.3-1 at PDF321 and PDF326; retain both separately.
Class3 physical Power Enable ON threshold strictly less than 5 Ohms; Class1&2 threshold differs.
Power Enable and isolated discrete logic thresholds not measured on actual sensor/case.
1PPS Rule cites Figure13.5.3.3-1 captioned J2 pin arrangement, not a verified timing waveform.
Original IEEE802.3-2008, AS6070/6, TIA/EIA422, ICD-GPS060B, MIL/ANSI/VITA originals unreviewed.
Class3 safety/NEZ/gimbal arming are physical controls, not executable CSAPI software Commands.
USB Host permission and 5V conditional power do not establish operating USB service.
Hand-controller Rule unconditional power wording versus conditional maximum Rule needs contextual interpretation.
Connector documentation not proof of installed serialized equipment or sensor subsystems.
Eight original C239 DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI companion originals, later S251 and restricted Appendix C still held.
No adopted DIM chassis/class/cardinality, CSAPI Profile SHALL or runtime/hardware conformance.
